==Notes==
*Using [[Shadow Sanctuary]] while under this [[chant]] will not make you lose [[blind]]ness. This is because you are blinded after this skill's effect is activated.
*Song of Purification will prevent [[Bleeding]] from being applied while using [[Cultist's Fervor]] (technically, the bleeding will have a duration of zero, which causes it to trigger [[Fragility]] and similar skills twice).
*Synergy with [[Wearying Spear]].
{{Bug|Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.}}
